description: Check whether one LLM model id is active, deprecated, or retired, plus its shutdown date and replacement, from that provider's deprecation page (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and other tracked LLM vendors). Use before hard-coding or calling a model, or when a call fails with model-not-found. Not for API uptime (check_api_status) and not for a retirement feed (list_recent_api_changes with kind model_retirement, or get_digest). Returns summary, verdict (active|deprecated|retired|unknown), recommended_action (keep_using|plan_migration|switch_now|verify_with_provider), replacement, shutdown_date, evidence, and freshness; pages are re-read every few hours. An unlisted id is verdict unknown, not an error; longer than 120 characters returns 400 bad_model_id. Example: {"model":"gpt-4-0613"}. Free within the daily quota, then $0.003 via x402. Alias: get_model (param id).

id.description: Deprecated alias of model, only for the get_model tool name. Same 1–120 character API id. Ignored when model is also set.

model.description: Exact API model id, not a display name or provider id. 1–120 characters; lowercased, and a leading models/ is stripped. Examples: gpt-4-0613, claude-3-opus-20240229, gemini-1.5-pro.

name: check_model_deprecation
title: Is this model deprecated, and what replaces it?
